title: Military video of instantaneous acceleration with a weapons-grade lock, obtained and released by Corbell and Knapp
summary: Jeremy Corbell tells of Military video of instantaneous acceleration with a weapons-grade lock, obtained and released by Corbell and Knapp, about unspecified at unspecified, and reports it citing named sources. As told, not a fact.

plain: A filmmaker and journalist, Jeremy Corbell, says that he and fellow journalist George Knapp got hold of a military video and released it to the public. As Corbell tells it, the video shows an object accelerating instantly while a military weapons system held a firm targeting lock on it, and analysis of the footage followed its release. If true, it would mean the military had recorded something moving in ways no known aircraft can.
